purpose.zh: 打开肩前侧和胸部，为过头动作做准备
purpose.en: Open your front shoulders and chest for overhead positions.

text.zh: 手臂伸直，毛巾画大弧举过头再向后
text.en: Keep your arms straight and arc the towel overhead and back

text.zh: 宽握毛巾拉紧，肋骨下沉
text.en: Hold the towel taut with a wide grip and ribs down.

text.zh: 腰不拱，肘弯了就把手再分开些
text.en: Do not arch your back; widen your grip if your elbows bend.

commonErrors.en: Bending the elbows to force it.

cautions.zh: 肩部疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your shoulders hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
